classification.difficultyReason: Construct a short reasoning chain from opposite-angle equality to a co-interior supplement.

content.prompt: Calculate $\angle CPE$ and $\angle PQD$ giving full reasoning.

spec.description: Vertical B-P-Q-E line and parallel rising A-P-C and F-Q-D lines, all with two endpoint arrowheads. Eight named points carry filled markers. Matching single chevrons on AP and FQ. Unfilled arcs at ∠BPA, ∠CPE and ∠PQD; 107° lies left of the upper given sector.
spec.mathematics: ∠CPE is vertically opposite the given 107°. ∠CPE and ∠PQD are co-interior angles on the marked parallel lines. Coordinates preserve the schematic source view rather than imposing measured angles.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 107° is supplied. No requested values appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
$\angle CPE=107^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

$\angle PQD+\angle CPE=180^\circ$ (co-interior angles on parallel lines).

$$\begin{align*}\angle PQD+107^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle PQD&=180^\circ-107^\circ\\\angle PQD&=73^\circ\end{align*}$$
